blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – An Octa research survey has shown that the hypothetical tandem of Vice President Sara Duterte and Sen. Robin Padilla held the national lead by 12 percent against that of Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo and Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino IV. Forty-eight percent of Filipinos chose the Sara-Robin tandem as their preferred presidential and vice presidential candidates in the 2028 polls. This is what Octa in its Tugon ng Masa Survey for the second quarter of 2026 showed.
